Product:{\"sku\":\"7100112254\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
The saga of Granblue Fantasy: Relink unfolds on the Nintendo Switch™ 2. Known for its dynamic combat, ensemble of versatile characters, and thrilling online co-op, this latest version of Relink features expanded solo and multiplayer content—bringing endless adventure to skyfarers both new and old.

Gameplay Features

Band together for exhilarating battles.
Form a party of four and depart for battle in this epic action RPG. Each character sports distinct combat mechanics, allowing for a whole crewful of unique playstyles. Weave these playstyles together using satisfying party-based attacks—like link attacks and chain bursts—to really make combat soar. Even recruits fresh to action gaming can take advantage of Assist Mode to reach the story's heart-pounding conclusion.

Embark on an endless variety of co-op quests.
A wide range of quests become available as the adventure unfolds. From unique boss fights to horde-survival missions, all quests are playable offline or online with up to four players. Whether it's casual questing or ultra-challenging end content, there's something for everyone to enjoy.

Discoveries Abound in Endless Ragnarok

Call in the big guns.
During their journey, players will unlock the ability to equip and call forth summons, adding a new dimension to battle strategy. Once channeled by Lyria, some summons can be directly controlled by the player. But, if certain conditions are met, others will make a spectacular entrance in a burst of glory—specifically, the "primal burst," a souped up version of the chain burst.

More to master, more to play—the adventure doesn't end at the credits!
• Take on co-op quest tiers and bosses of ever-increasing challenge.
• Enter the Conflux, a solo mode where unpredictable obstacles and enigmatic powers lurk.
• Unlock tons of playable characters, with master traits to push them beyond their limits.
• Enjoy online crossplay, as well as local co-op exclusive to Nintendo Switch™ 2.
